recent.text: News: The #Magic are finalizing a two-year deal with free agent guard Kevin Porter Jr., a league source confirmed to the @orlandosentinel. As I confirmed last night, Porter met with Orlando on Monday and now he’s going to fill the team’s 15th standard-contract roster spot.

recent.text: My @orlandosports recap as the #Magic drop a key NBA Cup game to the Pistons: “The main one was turnovers,” Sean Sweeney said when asked what led to Orlando’s issues vs. Detroit. “In the second quarter, we had a lot of turnovers.” https://t.co/OKzIURkwzT

recent.text: I asked Tristan da Silva about Orlando’s 11 second-quarter turnovers vs. Detroit and he mentioned the #Magic were playing into a crowd in that stretch: “Detroit did a great job of packing the paint and being aggressive on the ball when it (was) driven,” da Silva said.
